extraction.Name: McKay Kemble
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Ponca City, Okla. (agency not explicitly stated)
extraction.Recorded patent: yes, filed for record; receipted for yes; by whom: allottee; where: Noble County, Okla.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Sold to Leo Heney, for $3500 cash
extraction.Buyer: Leo Heney, for $3500.00 cash, which was a good price at that time
extraction.Occupation/Income: $45.00 per year from inherited land. No contribution from State or County.
extraction.NOTES: No property or money accumulated. Wife and three children. Both of Ponca City, Okla. File no. 61391. Document states: 'If the Indian appears to have been defrauded of his property... It does not appear so, in this case. However, it should be looked into.' Notarized November 23, 1928, before notary in Kay County, Oklahoma; commission expires 1931.
